reason: The CIF is parseable and round-trips as a primitive 141.0804 A^3 cell with eight fully occupied Lu sites (reduced composition Lu); symmetry analysis recovers P2_1, so the reported P1 listing is only an explicit setting. Indexing is strong (20/20 principal lines, M20=148.6), but peak-position coverage does not establish the coordinates. The supplied comparable-score report contains no score, and an audit whole-profile calculation of the instantiated CIF gives Rwp about 25.4% versus about 5.4% for a Pawley-style independent-intensity bound (roughly 22 times the residual sum of squares). Important intensity failures include 200 and 220 calculated as appreciable although observed nearly absent, and large errors for 010, 101, 011, and 201. The trace's final integrated-intensity objective was based on NNLS-extracted reflection amplitudes and did not demonstrate a comparable whole-pattern refinement; its displayed calculated sticks show the same discrepancies. Chemistry also vetoes this realization: complete periodic neighbor shells contain repeated Lu-Lu contacts at 1.826, 1.883, and 2.107 A, not merely a cutoff artifact. Thus the indexed lattice is credible, but the submitted atomic realization is not sufficiently established and another structure-solution attempt is likely to add a materially different viable candidate.
